rules.entry_structure: West champion LEFT / year-specific Finals logo CENTER / East champion RIGHT, using era-accurate team logos and team colors for that season.
rules.featured_players: Two Y2K-style players per Finals: the best player on each Finals team, nickname as the big title in a font/color picked for that player, meta NAME · POSITION · TEAM, team logo, jersey number, transparent cutout from a photo Lucian supplies.
rules.grading: At the end of the save, graded against real-life Houston: lost the 1986 Finals, first titles 1993-94 and 1994-95.
rules.source: Only results Lucian reports from his save. Never invent players, stats, teams, or results. Never correct his save to real-life history.

player_gif_note: Player figures are REAL PHOTOS cut to giant transparent PNGs (sprite GIFs removed 2026-11-12). Pose rule (Lucian, 2026-11-13): everyone hands on hips, one portrait per player reused across all their Finals — now true for every panel including Aguirre '89.

design.season_layout: Each season is ONE combined card. NO top matchup row: the Larry O'Brien trophy sits BETWEEN the two player GIF panels, with the year's real NBA Finals logo (era logoman for 1984/85) and the series score + champion under it (Lucian, 2026-11-12).
design.title_fonts: Player nickname titles use their team's font (Eriq P. Jaffe's NBA team lettering recreations): NBA Lakers, NBA Celtics, NBA 76ers, NBA Mavericks in assets/fonts/.
design.titles: Panel titles are the player's first and last name in their team's lettering font (Lucian, 2026-11-12) — no nicknames.
design.player_art: REAL player photos turned into giant cutout PNGs (Lucian, 2026-11-12 — every sprite GIF removed). POSE RULE (Lucian, 2026-11-13): every featured player on the site is HANDS ON HIPS — one supplied hero portrait per player, reused across all of that player's Finals (Magic: same portrait '84-'87; Jordan: same Sixers portrait '86+'87; Bird: long hair '84/'85, short hair '88 FMVP year). The old Bulls/Warriors jersey caveats are RESOLVED: Jordan's portrait is a real 76ers jersey and Mullin's is a real Nets jersey, both supplied by Lucian.
design.conference_sides: Western Conference team ALWAYS on the LEFT, Eastern Conference team ALWAYS on the RIGHT (Lucian, 2026-11-13). Series score reads West wins — East wins.
design.title_colors: Panel title text = the team's PRIMARY color, title shadow = the team's SECONDARY color (finals.json colors), font = the team's Jaffe lettering recreation (Lucian, 2026-11-13).
design.trophy_lean: The Larry O'Brien trophy in the versus column is oversized and TILTS/LEANS toward the side that won that year (lean-w for West champions, lean-e for East champions) (Lucian, 2026-11-13).
design.lakers_title: Lakers panel titles use the team's LOGO WORDMARK font (Bodoni Black Italic style — the official wordmark is Bauer Bodoni Black Italic) in GOLD with a purple shadow (Lucian, 2026-11-13: the Jaffe jersey-block font + purple text were wrong for Magic). Other teams audited against their logo wordmarks the same day — their Jaffe lettering matches; Lakers was the one lacking.
design.jordan_title: Jordan panel titles (76ers, 1986 + 1987): text RED #ED174C, shadow BLUE #006BB6 (Lucian, 2026-11-13 — overrides the default primary-text/secondary-shadow rule for Jordan; background unchanged, his correction: 'Shadow not background')
design.champion_trophy_backdrop: A featured player whose team WON that Finals gets a big Larry O'Brien trophy behind his name in his panel (.trophybg, dimmed so the name stands out against it) (Lucian, 2026-11-13).
design.uniform_evolution: Lucian 2026-11-13: audit every player's uniform per year; where a team's uniform changed between a player's Finals appearances, the portrait's uniform evolves to that year's design (his example: Mullin's '90 traditional vs '91 tie-dye Nets). Applied 2026-11-13 with pose-locked image edits: Jordan 1992 (1978-91 classic -> 1991-92 Sixers redesign), Aguirre 1993 (green -> 1992-93 royal blue), Magic 1987/1991/1992 (pre-1986-87 tilted script + big numbers -> straightened script + smaller number font). Researched correct and left alone: Lakers '84-'86, Celtics, Sixers '86/'87, Mavs '88/'89 green, Heat '89, Spurs '90, Mullin (set by Lucian).
design.pacers_title: Pacers titles: gold #FDBB30 text with navy #002D62 shadow (navy as text would vanish on the black stage).
design.finals_logos: Lucian 2026-11-13: Finals logos enlarged and shown as the bare design — white box removed (transparent), .flogo 168px desktop / 84px mobile. Follow-up fix the same day: white trapped inside the letterforms removed — digit counters keyed open, and the white script fills of the 1986-88 and 1991-93 logos recolored to each logo's own NBA blue so the whole set matches the 1989/1990 generation (blue script, red year, blue NBA).
design.era_ui: Lucian 2026-11-13: the UI treatment itself evolves by year — era-a 1984-85 heavy analog (scanlines .45, chromatic fringe on players, typewriter yearline), era-b 1986-87 (.26), era-c 1988-89 (.12), era-d 1990 on clean digital (no scanlines, crisper contrast).
design.ledger_removed: The Ledger section was removed 2026-11-13 at Lucian's order; the data lives in finals.json + README.
